meaning:
Μιχαήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִיכָאֵל, who like God?),
Michael, the Archangel (cf. Dan.12:1) : Ju 9, Rev.12:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said…
There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
